name: 2ic-heartbeat
monitorCommand: cd /home/bmazzarol/work/bmazzarol-bunnings && gh pr list --json number,state,reviewDecision 2>/dev/null; for f in state/floor/worker-*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"; done; for f in state/inflight/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"; done; herdr agent list 2>/dev/null || echo floor-down
tickPrompt: [HEARTBEAT] Run the supervise skill tick. Check all workers on the floor, reconcile state files against `herdr agent list`, and report any changes. If nothing changed since last tick, reply [SILENT].
